name: HDC HOLDINGS CO.,Ltd
summary: HDC HOLDINGS CO.,Ltd engages in real estate development and construction activities in South Korea. Its portfolio includes residential projects such as terrace houses, officetels, and apartments; and non-residential developments including offices, logistics centers, and knowledge industry centers, as well as operates a duty-free shop.
